sanskrit_verse: मित्रप्राप्त्यर्थलाभे वा राज्ञा लोकहितैषिणा / न मोक्तव्याः साहसिकाः सर्वलोकभयावहाः //
transliteration: mitraprāptyarthalābhe vā rājñā lokahitaiṣiṇā / na moktavyāḥ sāhasikāḥ sarvalokabhayāvahāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who seeks the welfare of the people and gains power or resources through friendship must never release those whose reckless actions threaten universal fear.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inseparable from responsibility for collective well-being.
Causation arises from alignment with dharma, not personal desire.
Capacity-based responsibility demands restraint over abdication.
Restoration logic requires containment of fear-inducing conduct.
Consciousness alignment necessitates discernment in liberation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A acquires authority via relational trust AND exhibits behavior inducing systemic fear, THEN revoke liberty privileges until integrity restoration.
IF entity E poses existential threat to societal equilibrium, THEN enforce containment protocols regardless of claimed intent.
IF ruler R releases dangerous actor D without full dharmic evaluation, THEN initiate corrective review by higher-consciousness tribunal.
supreme_court_application: In cases involving high-risk individuals whose actions generate widespread fear, the Supreme Court must prioritize societal stability over individual liberty claims. The threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable causality between action and mass disturbance, requiring immediate preventive measures rather than reactive justice.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that unchecked aggression leads to anupūrvaśaḥ — sequential breakdown of social order. Responsibility is proportional to capacity to harm; hence, release is denied not as punishment but as a protective measure ensuring alignment with cosmic law. Fear itself becomes the measurable datum for intervention.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process: isolate causative factor from further influence.
Assign responsibility assumption protocol: ruler must justify grounds for any proposed release.
Undertake capacity restoration: evaluate offender's readiness for reintegration sans risk.
Enforce integrity reintegration: public acknowledgment of harm and structured rehabilitation plan.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this edict stands as Sanatana Dharma executed. Fearless governance flows from conscious containment. Liberation is conditional upon universal safety. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
